title: ATR-buffer family under volatility-cluster-preserving block Null C
block_policy: pin opening atom; partition all later atoms into contiguous blocks; permute every block including a shorter terminal block
fixed_control: cell-specific k times the draw-specific unconditional median causal ATR_N
selection_statistic: select the N-k scaled cell with maximum Sharpe within every draw; compare with its cell-specific matched fixed buffer
primary_metric: family-selected scaled-minus-fixed zero-day daily net Sharpe uplift
secondary_metric: family-selected scaled-minus-close-confirmed zero-day daily net Sharpe uplift
kill_test: real must beat all three block-null distributions at upper-tail p<=0.05 and z>=2 with non-positive null centers
data_scope: NQ clean one-minute Databento RTH through 2026-07-14; consumed history
